backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no logic implemented.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing online‑only requirements, affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of various frontend components and assets.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles and OKLCH color variables defining the app’s light/dark themes.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry including PWA metadata, icons, and script bootstrap for the React app.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, icons, categories, shortcuts, and display behavior.
frontend/public/offline.html: Standalone offline page informing users the game requires internet and offering retry logic.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker enforcing online‑only gameplay by caching only offline assets and forcing network fetches.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component with header, help dialog, game container, footer, and service worker registration.
frontend/src/components/AboutHelp.tsx: Help/About component describing gameplay, controls, internet requirement, and legal notes.
frontend/src/components/OnlineRequiredBl: Full-screen overlay warning the user they are offline with a retry button.
frontend/src/game/controls/TouchControls: Mobile touch UI buttons for left, right, and brake mapped to shared game controls.
frontend/src/game/controls/useGameContro: Global keyboard and touch control state manager with a hook for listening to updates.
3D gameplay scene handling player movement, obstacle spawning, scoring, and collision detection.
frontend/src/game/TrafficJamGame.tsx: Main game wrapper managing state, score, online status, and rendering the scene, HUD, and offline blocker.
frontend/src/game/ui/GameHud.tsx: HUD showing the score and a game-over screen with restart controls.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider managing Internet Identity auth, login flow, and stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnlineStatus.ts: Tracks browser online/offline status and exposes a manual recheck function.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom racing-themed color variables for light and dark mode.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point setting up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and rendering the root component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, custom OKLCH color variables, extended animations, and typography/container/animation plugins.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s current scope for a legal browser-based 3D traffic‑jam game and lists architectural notes and existing features with requirement links.
